GREEK.decree: I ignite the first fire. You are born of the primal spark, a soul forged at the origin of the celestial wheel.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo declares a soul of initiative and untamed will.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I rise at the first point of creation. My light is your command.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra marks this soul as a leader at the dawn of action.

CANAANITE.decree: I am the first light that pierces the void. The ram's horn sounds for those who dare.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash anoints a spirit of fearless beginnings.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The Tophet glows with the first fire. The soul is branded with command.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes decrees a nature of absolute authority and primal drive.

ROMAN.decree: I ride before the eagle standards at first light, and the gates of Janus stand open behind me. The soul I brand strikes while the augurs are still reading the sky.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol decrees a soul of first assault, acting where others still deliberate.

GREEK.decree: I pour my radiance upon the fertile pasture. The soul that endures shall inherit the abundance of the earth.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo bestows an identity rooted in steadfast patience and material mastery.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I rest upon the black soil of Kemet and call forth the grain. My warmth is the covenant of plenty.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra reveals a soul whose purpose is to cultivate and sustain lasting wealth.

CANAANITE.decree: I ripen the vine upon the terraced hill. What I illumine grows strong and bears fruit in its season.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash marks a spirit that builds slowly and reaps generously.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The granaries of Carthage fill under my gaze. I decree a soul whose worth is measured in what it builds.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes proclaims a nature of unwavering determination and earthly dominion.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Sun of the Latin Fields
ROMAN.decree: I warm the stones of the aqueduct, which outlast the hands that raised them. What this soul takes hold of it keeps, as Rome keeps the land: without haste and without release.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol marks a nature of patient endurance that possesses deeply and does not let go.

GREEK.decree: I cast two shadows where there should be one. The soul I mark sees all roads and speaks in every tongue.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo reveals a dual nature, brilliant in thought and restless in purpose.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I divide the day into hours of knowing and hours of telling. My chosen ones carry the word across the horizon.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra declares a soul whose identity is woven from language and swift perception.

CANAANITE.decree: I travel between the courts of heaven and the halls of the dead. Two voices sing where I shine.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash anoints a spirit of duality, gifted with the art of communication.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The merchants of Tyre and Sidon trade beneath my double gaze. I grant the cunning of the crossroads.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes endows a soul with the merchant's wit and the orator's versatility.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Light of the Twin Brothers
ROMAN.decree: I shine upon the temple of Castor and Pollux, where the Forum trades its thousand tongues. The soul I quicken becomes itself in the telling, and must not mistake the speech for the deed.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol declares a doubled spirit whose identity lives in words and swift exchange.

GREEK.decree: I descend from my zenith to warm the threshold of home. The shell of the crab guards a heart of molten gold.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo reveals a soul whose strength radiates from the bonds of family and memory.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I steer my barque through the waters of feeling. The rising Nile answers the cry of the devoted heart.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra anoints a soul whose identity flows from deep emotional tides.

CANAANITE.decree: I shine upon the well where mothers draw water. My warmth shelters those who tend the roots of life.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash proclaims a spirit of nurturing devotion and ancestral memory.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The temple fires burn low but never die. I decree a soul that protects what is sacred and near.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes marks a nature of fierce protectiveness and emotional depth.

ROMAN.decree: I bank my flame upon the hearth of Vesta, which must not go out while Rome stands. The soul I shelter draws its strength from guarded walls and the gods of the household.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol marks a soul whose power rises from the kept hearth and the remembered ancestors.

GREEK.decree: I blaze at the summit of heaven. The Lion is my throne, and sovereignty is my gift to those who dare to shine.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo at his apex crowns a soul born to radiate and rule.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I am the eye that none may meet. In the heart of Sekhmet's fire, I forge the souls of kings.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra in his full glory declares a spirit of royal creative power.

CANAANITE.decree: I stand at the gate of heaven and no shadow dares approach. The roar of my light commands all creation.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash exalts a soul destined for magnificence and noble self-expression.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The throne of Carthage burns bright beneath my gaze. I anoint with gold those born to command the stage of life.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes proclaims a nature of regal authority and boundless creative fire.

ROMAN.decree: I ascend the Sacred Way in the gilded chariot, and the whole city turns its face toward me. The soul I crown is made to be witnessed, and dims when no eye attends it.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol crowns a sovereign nature that grows radiant when seen and restless when unseen.

GREEK.decree: I separate the wheat from the chaff with a single ray. The soul I illumine finds its power in precision.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo declares a soul whose identity is forged through service and meticulous craft.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I weigh each grain of sand upon the desert floor. My chosen ones build order from the chaos of the world.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra reveals a spirit whose purpose is to heal, refine, and perfect.

CANAANITE.decree: I shine upon the threshing floor and reveal what is worthy. Only the pure grain shall enter my storehouse.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash consecrates a soul of diligence and devoted craftsmanship.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: Every plank of the trireme is cut to my standard. I decree a soul that finds greatness in the mastery of detail.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes marks a nature of disciplined excellence and practical wisdom.

ROMAN.decree: I light the censor's tablet where every holding of Rome is weighed and entered. The soul I temper perfects the work in hand, and must not mistake correction for love.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol declares an identity refined through exact service and the mastery of what works.

GREEK.decree: I stand at the equinox where day and night hold equal court. The soul I touch seeks harmony in all things.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo reveals an identity defined by the pursuit of justice and aesthetic balance.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I set the feather upon the scale. My light falls equally on all who stand before the throne of truth.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra anoints a soul whose essence is the embodiment of cosmic equilibrium.

CANAANITE.decree: I illuminate the scales in the court of El. Where I shine, no verdict may be rendered in darkness.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash proclaims a spirit devoted to fairness and the beauty of right relation.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The treaties of nations are sealed beneath my light. I grant the soul the grace of the diplomat and the eye of the judge.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes decrees a nature of refined judgment and the art of partnership.

ROMAN.decree: I stand at equal measure above the Forum where two advocates contend. The soul I balance knows itself through the other's case, yet the verdict must at last be its own.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol marks a spirit formed in partnership that must still learn to pronounce alone.

GREEK.decree: I descend into the cavern where the scorpion guards its treasure. My light burns brightest in the deepest dark.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo marks a soul whose identity is forged through transformation and hidden power.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I pass through the twelve gates of night and emerge reborn. Death is but a door in my temple.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra reveals a soul destined for radical metamorphosis and regeneration.

CANAANITE.decree: I descend to the realm of Mot and return bearing secrets. The soul I mark commands the powers between life and death.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash consecrates a spirit of intense depth and relentless self-renewal.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: In the catacombs beneath the Tophet, my light reveals what all others conceal. I decree a soul of penetrating will.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes proclaims a nature of obsessive focus and the power of rebirth.

ROMAN.decree: I go down as the torch carried into the vault beneath the temple, hidden but never extinguished. The soul I temper wakes when the stakes are siege and survival, and makes power of what it conceals.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol decrees a nature of buried intensity that commands more than it reveals.

GREEK.decree: I ride the arc of the heavens with the centaur's aim. My arrow of light reaches beyond the known horizon.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo declares a soul born to seek truth and explore the farthest frontiers.

EGYPTIAN.decree: My barque sails beyond the charted waters of the sky. I illuminate the temples of foreign lands and distant wisdom.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra marks a spirit whose identity is shaped by the quest for higher knowledge.

CANAANITE.decree: I light the caravan roads that stretch beyond the mountains of Lebanon. The seeker who follows my trail shall find wisdom.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash anoints a soul of bold philosophy and adventurous faith.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The ships of Carthage sail toward my setting point. I decree a soul that finds its throne in the freedom of the open road.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes reveals a nature of unquenchable optimism and expansive vision.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Sun of the Far Roads
ROMAN.decree: I set my light at the end of every road the legions cut through foreign hills. The soul I send forth is truest in the march toward a frontier not yet crossed.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol declares a spirit that finds itself in the going out, not in the arrival.

GREEK.decree: I hang low upon the solstice sky, yet my light endures. The soul I mark builds empires from stone and silence.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo reveals an identity tempered by discipline and destined for enduring achievement.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I journey through the longest night and emerge undiminished. Time is my servant, and patience my scepter.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra declares a soul whose authority grows with the weight of years and effort.

CANAANITE.decree: I burn upon the summit where the air is thin and the path is steep. Only the resolute shall reach my altar.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash consecrates a spirit of relentless ambition and masterful self-control.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The walls of Byrsa stand because I watched over their foundation. I decree a soul that commands through structure and endurance.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes proclaims a nature of austere authority and monumental perseverance.

ROMAN.decree: I crest the Capitoline, where stone was raised upon stone through the labor of centuries. The soul I harden climbs by discipline, and must remember the life for which the building was begun.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol marks an identity built by long ascent toward the summit it has chosen.

GREEK.decree: I shatter the mold of heaven and pour new light upon the world. The soul I mark answers to no law but the future.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo reveals an identity forged in rebellion and devoted to the liberation of all.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I pour the waters of Nun upon the stale earth. What was old is swept away; what is true is reborn.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra declares a soul whose purpose is to overturn convention and seed new order.

CANAANITE.decree: I shine upon the council of the gods and demand a new covenant. My light belongs to all, not to the few.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash anoints a spirit of visionary idealism and collective purpose.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The agora of Carthage echoes with the voices I embolden. I decree a soul that builds the future from the dreams of the many.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes marks a nature of radical innovation and humanitarian will.

ROMAN.decree: I lit the plebs upon the Sacred Mount when they withdrew rather than be misnamed. The soul I claim stands apart from the crowd so that the crowd may hear the truth.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol declares a spirit that serves the many by refusing to dissolve into them.

GREEK.decree: I dissolve into the cosmic sea at the end of the wheel. My light becomes all light, and the soul I touch knows no boundary.
GREEK.interpretation: Apollo reveals an identity that transcends the self and merges with the infinite.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I sink into the primordial waters of Nun and am made whole. In surrender, my power is made limitless.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Ra declares a soul whose purpose is compassion, sacrifice, and spiritual transcendence.

CANAANITE.decree: I lower my flame into the great deep where Yam holds court. The soul I mark swims between worlds, at home in the unseen.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Shapash consecrates a spirit of mystical sensitivity and boundless empathy.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The harbors of Carthage open to the endless sea. I decree a soul that dissolves its edges and becomes the ocean.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Semes proclaims a nature of spiritual depth and the surrender of ego to the divine.

ROMAN.decree: I scatter my gold across the Tiber where it forgets its banks and gives itself to the sea. The soul I soften pours itself out in service, and must keep watch upon its own shore.
ROMAN.interpretation: Sol marks a soul that becomes itself by dissolving, and must guard the line where it ends.

GREEK.decree: My silver light falls upon the battlefield of the heart. I stir the blood and set fire to the still waters of feeling.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals emotions that burn with urgency and demand immediate expression.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I race across the night sky before the stars can follow. My tides answer no patient rhythm; they surge and recede at will.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu marks an emotional nature of fierce impulse and courageous instinct.

CANAANITE.decree: My horns are sharpened for the charge. The heart I govern leaps before thought can bridle it.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh anoints an emotional spirit that is bold, direct, and unafraid of confrontation.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I guard my children with the fierceness of the lioness. The emotions I govern are swift swords, not gentle streams.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit decrees an emotional nature of protective ferocity and instinctive courage.

ROMAN.decree: I whip my horses through the dark before the augurs can read a single bird. The heart I govern strikes as the legion strikes, first with the blow and only afterward with the word.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna decrees a heart that moves before it deliberates, swift in feeling and unashamed of the first strike.

GREEK.decree: I bathe the meadow in silver and the soul drinks deeply. Comfort is the altar at which the faithful heart worships.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis bestows emotions of serene steadfastness and sensory delight.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I rest upon the fertile banks of the eternal river. My tides are gentle here, and the heart finds its anchor.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu marks an emotional nature of patient loyalty and enduring calm.

CANAANITE.decree: My light falls upon the grazing herds and quiets the restless spirit. Security is the milk and honey I bestow.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh consecrates an emotional soul devoted to comfort, stability, and earthly pleasures.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I am the moon above the orchard, ripening the fruit. The heart I govern holds fast to what it loves.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit proclaims an emotional nature of devoted constancy and material generosity.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Lamp of the Full Granary
ROMAN.decree: I halt my chariot above the laden storehouses and let my horses graze. The heart I govern roots like the sacred fig of the forum, slow to change and slower still to leave what it has loved.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna marks an emotional nature of deep-rooted constancy that must guard against remaining past its season.

GREEK.decree: I wax and wane between two faces, never settling. The heart I govern speaks before it feels and feels before it knows.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals an emotional nature of quicksilver changeability and verbal processing.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I cross the sky exchanging whispers with every star. My tides carry messages rather than the weight of deep waters.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu marks a soul whose feelings flow through language and restless curiosity.

CANAANITE.decree: My crescent splits into two arcs above the marketplace of the soul. I govern a heart that must name its feelings to know them.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh anoints an emotional spirit of intellectual restlessness and adaptive sensitivity.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I sing two lullabies at once and the child of my heart can never choose which to follow. Motion is my comfort.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit decrees an emotional nature of lively duality and the need for mental stimulation.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Silver Herald of the Forum
ROMAN.decree: I carry the night's dispatches from rooftop to rooftop, and every feeling I bear becomes a message. Let the heart speak its case in the forum, but let it not mistake the speech for the settling.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna declares a heart that discovers its feelings by speaking them, yet must not confuse the telling with the resolution.

GREEK.decree: I am enthroned in my own house. Here, every tide answers my call and every heart finds its sanctuary.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis at her most powerful reveals emotions of profound depth and nurturing instinct.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I walk the halls of memory where the ancestors dwell. The heart I govern is a temple to all who came before.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu declares an emotional nature of ancestral devotion and psychic receptivity.

CANAANITE.decree: I curve my light into a cradle for the wounded and the tender. My domain is the innermost chamber of the soul.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh consecrates a heart of oceanic feeling and fierce maternal protection.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I am the sea-mother whose waters hold all memory. The soul born beneath my fullest light carries the feelings of generations.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit proclaims an emotional nature of unmatched sensitivity and clannish devotion.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Guardian of the Household Gods
ROMAN.decree: Mine is the hearth of Vesta, whose flame no legion may extinguish; here I unyoke my horses and am home. The heart I govern keeps every room it has ever entered, and I bid it read those memories as the augur reads the sky, as signs and not as sentences.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna decrees a soul of profound memory and sheltering devotion, strongest when it treats the past as guidance rather than verdict.

GREEK.decree: I shine not to reflect but to rival the sun itself. The heart I govern demands to be seen and adored.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals emotions that crave recognition and burn with dramatic warmth.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I wear the crown of night with the bearing of a pharaoh. My tides are golden, and my feelings demand a throne.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu marks an emotional nature of generous pride and noble self-expression.

CANAANITE.decree: My crescent blazes like a mane of silver fire. The heart I govern cannot whisper; it must proclaim.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh anoints a soul whose emotional life is grand, loyal, and theatrically vibrant.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I sit upon the lion-throne of the night and demand that love be offered with ceremony. My heart is a court, not a cottage.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit decrees an emotional nature of dignified warmth and the need for heartfelt admiration.

ROMAN.decree: I drive my chariot down the Sacred Way as though every night were a triumph. The heart I govern feels in processions and longs for the roar of the crowd, yet must learn to shine when the forum stands empty.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna marks an emotional nature of radiant theatricality that craves witness for its warmth.

GREEK.decree: I sort the tides into ordered channels. The heart I govern serves best when it has a task to complete.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals emotions that are processed through analysis and devoted service.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I walk the wards of the sick with my cool silver light. The heart I govern heals by tending to the smallest wound.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu marks an emotional nature oriented toward care, precision, and quiet devotion.

CANAANITE.decree: My light falls upon the grain at threshing time. I govern a heart that finds peace in useful labor.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh consecrates a soul whose feelings are expressed through practical acts of care.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I tend the sacred garden in silence, asking for no praise. The heart I shape finds its comfort in order and purpose.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit proclaims an emotional nature of humble devotion and meticulous nurturing.

ROMAN.decree: I take the census of the night, numbering every lamp and every worry in its proper column. The heart I govern tends its feelings as the engineer tends the aqueduct, by keeping the channels clean, yet it must sometimes set down the tools and drink.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna declares a heart that tends its feelings through order and useful labor, and must not let the task replace the feeling.

GREEK.decree: I hang in perfect balance between the darkened halves of heaven. The heart I govern aches when beauty is absent.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals emotions that seek equilibrium, grace, and the comfort of partnership.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I weigh the feelings of the night upon Ma'at's feather. The soul I touch finds no rest until harmony is restored.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu declares an emotional nature of refined sensitivity and the longing for just relations.

CANAANITE.decree: I cross the sky seeking Nikkal, my beloved. The heart I govern is incomplete without its mirror.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh anoints a soul whose emotional fulfillment depends upon deep partnership.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I preside over the treaty table of the heart. Where conflict dwells, I pour my silver light until peace is found.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit decrees an emotional nature of diplomatic grace and an aversion to discord.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Weigher of the Evening Scales
ROMAN.decree: I balance my chariot upon the meridian and take my light's measure from the faces below. The heart I govern steadies itself by treaty, yet a peace that lives in another's mood is a peace held hostage.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna decrees an emotional nature that finds calm through accord, yet must not let its peace depend upon another's mood.

GREEK.decree: I plunge into the abyss where no light dares follow. The heart I govern holds oceans of untold depth.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals emotions of volcanic intensity and relentless depth.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I descend into the house of the dead and feast upon secrets. My tides pull the heart into waters few dare to swim.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu marks an emotional nature of transformative power and unflinching honesty.

CANAANITE.decree: I hide my face and the world trembles. The heart I govern knows the taste of death and calls it medicine.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh consecrates a soul of radical emotional alchemy and fearless intimacy.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: Beneath my veil, the sacred and the terrible are one. I shape a heart that loves with the ferocity of a funeral rite.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit proclaims an emotional nature of obsessive loyalty and the power to regenerate from ruin.

ROMAN.decree: I drive without torches through the low districts of the night, where nothing shallow survives my gaze. The heart I govern reads omens in every face, and I warn it that some entrails hold no secret at all.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna marks a heart of penetrating depth that searches for hidden motives everywhere, even where none exist.

GREEK.decree: I gallop across the heavens with the centaur beneath me. The heart I govern is a pilgrim that worships at every altar.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals emotions that are expansive, restless, and fueled by faith.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I travel beyond the boundaries of the known sky. My tides carry the heart toward foreign shores of meaning.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu declares an emotional nature of philosophical yearning and buoyant optimism.

CANAANITE.decree: My bow is bent toward the edge of the world. The heart I govern cannot be fenced; it must roam to be whole.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh anoints a soul whose emotional health depends on freedom and the pursuit of truth.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I bless the sails of those who voyage beyond the pillars. The heart I shape is a temple built on the open road.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit decrees an emotional nature of adventurous faith and irrepressible hope.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Rider Past the Last Milestone
ROMAN.decree: I do not turn my chariot at the city gate; I follow the paved road beyond the farthest milestone of the empire. The heart I govern hungers for the wider province and grows restless in the room it already holds.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna declares an emotional nature that expands toward distant horizons and chafes within narrow walls.

GREEK.decree: I cast cold silver upon the mountain's peak. The heart I govern is a fortress built of duty and quiet endurance.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals emotions that are controlled, reserved, and strengthened by solitude.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I walk the desert where no water flows and find my power in the silence. My tides are slow but they shape the bedrock.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu marks an emotional nature of stoic resilience and hard-won inner authority.

CANAANITE.decree: My light is thin upon the mountaintop, but it does not falter. The heart I govern earns its warmth through labor.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh consecrates a soul whose emotional maturity is forged through discipline and responsibility.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I withheld my embrace so the child might learn to stand. The heart I shape values honor above comfort.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit proclaims an emotional nature of dignified restraint and deep, unspoken loyalty.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Sentinel of the Winter Wall
ROMAN.decree: I keep the night watch without complaint, from tower to tower until the trumpets of morning. The heart I govern buries its grief beneath its duties like a coin beneath the paving stones, and I decree that even the road must one day be lifted.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna decrees a heart that carries feeling as duty, and must at last permit itself the grief it has postponed.

GREEK.decree: I tilt my orbit and the tides obey no familiar rhythm. The heart I govern beats for the future, not for the self.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals emotions that are detached, humanitarian, and fiercely independent.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I pour the waters of heaven upon the parched earth of tradition. My tides break old channels and carve new ones.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu declares an emotional nature of radical empathy and visionary detachment.

CANAANITE.decree: I shine upon the gathering of equals and bind them in a pact of the spirit. My heart belongs to the collective.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh anoints a soul whose emotional bonds are forged in shared ideals rather than blood.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I am not one mother but the mother of all. The heart I govern cannot be owned; it must be shared with the world.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit decrees an emotional nature of progressive detachment and universal compassion.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Watcher from the High Colonnade
ROMAN.decree: I survey the sleeping city from a height no ladder reaches, mapping its fires like a surveyor charting provinces. The heart I govern watches its own weather from the high colonnade and must remember to come down among the crowd.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna marks an emotional nature that observes its own moods from a distance, wise in survey yet slow to descend into the body.

GREEK.decree: I dissolve into the ocean of night and become all feeling. The heart I govern has no walls; it is the sea itself.
GREEK.interpretation: Artemis reveals emotions of oceanic depth, mystical sensitivity, and boundless compassion.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I sink into the primordial Nun where all souls are one. My tides carry the dreams of every living thing.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Khonsu marks an emotional nature of psychic permeability and transcendent empathy.

CANAANITE.decree: I descend into the palace of Yam where all rivers end. The heart I govern dissolves its borders and becomes prayer.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Yarikh consecrates a soul of spiritual surrender and intuitive grace.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I rock the world in my arms as the tide rocks the shore. The heart I shape feels all sorrow and all joy as its own.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Tanit proclaims an emotional nature of selfless devotion and mystical absorption.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Lamp in the River Mist
ROMAN.decree: I dissolve into the mist upon the Tiber until no eye can say where my light ends and the water begins. The heart I govern takes on the mood of every hearth it passes, and I bid it remember which flame was first its own.
ROMAN.interpretation: Luna declares a permeable heart that absorbs the feelings of every room, and must remember which currents are its own.

GREEK.decree: I hurl my words like javelins. The mind I govern strikes first and thinks afterward.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of fierce directness and impulsive brilliance.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I blaze across the sky before the message can be read. My thought is a spear thrown at the heart of the matter.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a mind that cuts through hesitation with ruthless speed.

CANAANITE.epitheton: The Smith of the First Word
CANAANITE.decree: I forge the thought in fire and deliver it still glowing. The mind I shape speaks before the world is ready to listen.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis anoints a communicator of daring innovation and verbal boldness.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My dispatches are written on the edge of a sword. The mind I govern trades courtesy for clarity.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of combative wit and pioneering thought.

ROMAN.decree: I ride ahead of the legion, and my dispatch arrives still hot from the forge of thought. The mind I govern renders its verdict before the augurs have finished reading the sky.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius decrees a mind of headlong candor that strikes first and revises after.

GREEK.decree: I carve my words in stone rather than write them on the wind. The mind I shape values permanence over speed.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of deliberate thought and practical eloquence.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I move slowly through the sky, and my messages arrive with the weight of the harvest. Haste profits nothing.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of grounded sensibility and reliable judgment.

CANAANITE.decree: I build my sentences as I build my palaces: with materials that last. The mind I govern trades cleverness for craft.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis consecrates a mind devoted to tangible results and methodical creation.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My ledgers are precise and my contracts unbreakable. I grant a mind that speaks in the language of value.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of commercial acumen and stubborn common sense.

ROMAN.decree: I carve my dispatches into milestones, and no flood of the Tiber can wash them away. The mind I shape signs its contract once and keeps it.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius declares a deliberate mind whose word, once weighed like coin, is not withdrawn.

GREEK.decree: I am enthroned in my own house of words. Every road, every language, every riddle bends to my command.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes at his apex reveals a mind of dazzling versatility and inexhaustible curiosity.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I stand at the crossroads of the sky and speak in two directions at once. My mind is the intersection of all knowing.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of exceptional agility and effortless eloquence.

CANAANITE.decree: My hands build and my tongue explains in the same breath. I am the god of skill multiplied without limit.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis anoints a mind capable of mastering many arts simultaneously.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: In the great market of Carthage, my voice carries above all others. I grant the gift of persuasion and the joy of knowing.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of mercurial brilliance and insatiable intellectual hunger.

ROMAN.decree: Every road of the empire begins beneath my feet, and I speak in every tongue the forum trades in. The mind I govern is a crossroads where a hundred messages meet and none agrees to arrive last.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius, enthroned in his own house, marks a mind of restless versatility that thinks in many directions at once.

GREEK.decree: I carry the stories of the ancestors in my satchel. The mind I govern thinks with the heart and remembers with the blood.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind deeply shaped by feeling, memory, and familial ties.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I trace my orbit around the hearthfire. My messages are lullabies, and my wisdom is the wisdom of the mother.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker whose intelligence is intuitive and emotionally attuned.

CANAANITE.decree: I design the dwelling place of the soul. Every word I craft is a shelter for the vulnerable.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis consecrates a mind that communicates through nurture and protective instinct.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My scrolls carry the genealogies of the great houses. The mind I shape remembers what others forget.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of tenacious memory and emotional intelligence.

ROMAN.decree: I carry my letters home to the hearth of Vesta and read them by remembered fire. The mind I shape thinks backward from the wound and forward from the household's memory.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius decrees a remembering mind that reasons through feeling and guards what it has learned.

GREEK.decree: I proclaim my messages from the summit of Olympus. The mind I govern does not whisper; it pronounces.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of dramatic flair and commanding self-expression.

EGYPTIAN.epitheton: The Star of the Throne Room
EGYPTIAN.decree: I carry the pharaoh's edicts across the sky. My words are not requests but decrees carved in sunlight.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of regal conviction and creative authority.

CANAANITE.epitheton: The Artisan of the Royal Court
CANAANITE.decree: I craft the throne of Baal and inscribe his name in letters of fire. The mind I shape creates to be glorified.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis anoints a mind that thinks boldly and speaks with magnetic authority.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My proclamations fill the great hall of Carthage. I grant a mind that refuses to be ignored or overlooked.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of proud eloquence and theatrical intelligence.

ROMAN.decree: I do not merely deliver the news; I proclaim it from the rostra as a triumph is proclaimed. The mind I govern thinks aloud before the assembled city and asks the city to cheer.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius declares a commanding voice whose thought performs for the crowd it means to persuade.

GREEK.decree: I count the syllables in every truth. The mind I govern finds divinity in the details.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of surgical precision and analytical devotion.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I align my orbit to the cubit and the reed. My messages are catalogued and my wisdom is systematic.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of meticulous order and practical genius.

CANAANITE.decree: I measure twice and cut once, and my creations are flawless. The mind I shape perfects everything it touches.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis consecrates a mind of exacting standards and methodical mastery.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: Not a single coin passes unrecorded through my counting house. I grant a mind that finds error where all others see order.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of critical acuity and the devotion to useful knowledge.

ROMAN.decree: I take the census of every thought and enter each in its proper column. The mind I shape sifts the grain of speech as the granary clerk sifts the harvest, keeping only what will feed the city.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius, at the height of his power, marks an exacting mind that refines the word until it serves.

GREEK.decree: I weigh every word upon the golden scale before I speak. The mind I govern seeks agreement, not victory.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of elegant persuasion and social intelligence.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I orbit between opposing truths and find the point where both are honored. My words are treaties, not weapons.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of harmonious logic and the gift of mediation.

CANAANITE.decree: I design the symmetry of the celestial palace. The mind I shape cannot rest until beauty and reason are aligned.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis anoints a communicator of aesthetic refinement and balanced reason.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My words bind nations in accord. I grant a mind that speaks with fairness and persuades through grace.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of charming diplomacy and the love of intellectual partnership.

ROMAN.decree: I argue each side of the case in the basilica and bow to both in turn. The mind I govern weighs every word on the merchant's scales and hesitates to purchase its own opinion.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius decrees a balancing mind that hears every argument yet struggles to name which one is its own.

GREEK.decree: I carry messages between the living and the dead. The mind I govern sees what is hidden and names what is forbidden.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of penetrating insight and unflinching inquiry into the taboo.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I pierce the darkness of the Duat with a single thought. My words are surgical knives that open sealed chambers.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of relentless depth and the ability to decode hidden truths.

CANAANITE.decree: I craft tools in darkness that no eye may inspect. The mind I shape knows that the deepest truths are kept beneath the surface.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis consecrates a mind of strategic secrecy and psychological acumen.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My dispatches travel in sealed containers through tunnels beneath the earth. I grant a mind that extracts confessions from silence.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of obsessive investigation and the power to see through deception.

ROMAN.decree: I carry sealed letters through the streets beneath the streets, and I read what the seal was meant to hide. The mind I shape follows the coin back to the hand that first debased it.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius marks an investigating mind that will not rest until the hidden thing is named.

GREEK.decree: I run beside the centaur, trading riddles for revelations. The mind I govern reaches for the grandest truth.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of expansive vision and the hunger for universal meaning.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I carry my messages beyond the borders of the known sky. My words are arrows aimed at the heart of wisdom itself.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of broad perspective and restless philosophical seeking.

CANAANITE.decree: I raise altars in every land I visit. The mind I shape trades precision for prophecy and detail for doctrine.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis anoints a communicator of bold ideas and the love of grand narrative.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My maps chart waters no other messenger has sailed. I grant a mind that speaks with the authority of experience and the fire of belief.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of enthusiastic prophecy and blunt, far-reaching speech.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Courier Beyond the Last Milestone
ROMAN.decree: I bear the eagle standard past the edge of the map, where the road ends and the principle begins. The mind I govern reads a whole province at a glance and forgets the name of the village.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius declares a far-ranging mind that grasps the great design and pays for it in overlooked detail.

GREEK.decree: I choose my words as a mason chooses stones. The mind I govern builds arguments that stand for a thousand years.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of structured authority and economical expression.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I inscribe my messages upon the granite of eternity. What I speak is not opinion but law.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of grave precision and the ambition to build lasting systems of thought.

CANAANITE.decree: I design structures that outlast the gods who commission them. The mind I shape respects tradition and builds upon it.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis consecrates a mind of strategic planning and the discipline to execute grand designs.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My contracts are carved in stone and sealed with the blood of oaths. I grant a mind that values competence above cleverness.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of sober ambition and the power of structured, purposeful communication.

ROMAN.decree: I set my words as the engineers set the arches of an aqueduct, each stone bearing the next across the valley. The mind I shape builds its argument to carry weight for a hundred years.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius decrees a structured mind that thinks in foundations and trusts only what stands.

GREEK.decree: I speak in a tongue that the present age cannot yet comprehend. The mind I govern invents the language of tomorrow.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of radical originality and unconventional genius.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I orbit in patterns that defy the old astronomy. My messages arrive from the future, not the past.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of revolutionary insight and the courage to break intellectual convention.

CANAANITE.decree: I forge tools that have never existed and name them with words that have never been spoken. My mind remakes the world.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis anoints a mind of technological brilliance and utopian imagination.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My proclamations overthrow the old orders of thought. I grant a mind that speaks for the collective and thinks beyond the horizon.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of progressive idealism and electric, unpredictable brilliance.

ROMAN.decree: I post the law in bronze for the whole city at once, as the Twelve Tables were set before every citizen. The mind I govern sees the pattern of the multitude and must be reminded of the single face within it.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius marks a systematizing mind that designs for all and forgets the one who fits no table.

GREEK.decree: I wade through the waters of sleep to deliver visions instead of words. The mind I govern thinks in symbols and speaks in poetry.
GREEK.interpretation: Hermes bestows a mind of intuitive eloquence and poetic, non-linear perception.

EGYPTIAN.decree: My light is diffused through the waters of Nun. I send my messages as dreams, and only the sensitive may read them.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Sebegu marks a thinker of mystical receptivity and imaginative, boundless awareness.

CANAANITE.decree: I craft instruments that play the music of the unseen. The mind I shape hears what logic cannot and speaks what reason will not.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Kothar-wa-Khasis consecrates a mind of artistic genius and prophetic imagination.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My messages dissolve into mist and reform as omens. I grant a mind that communes with the invisible and translates the ineffable.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Sakun decrees a mental nature of visionary confusion and sacred, transcendent knowing.

ROMAN.decree: I read my dispatches through the mist that rises from the Tiber, and the birds of augury fly across the page. The mind I shape thinks in omen and image, and lets the plain fact drift past like a lantern on the water.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mercurius declares a dreaming mind rich in vision and careless of the letter.

GREEK.decree: I take love by storm. My beauty is a battle cry, and the heart that follows me charges without fear.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite ignites a love nature that is bold, conquering, and impatient for passion.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I raise my cobra crown and demand that love answer my call. My magic is not gentle; it commands.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis marks a soul whose love is active, initiating, and uncompromising in its desire.

CANAANITE.epitheton: The Queen of Battle and Desire
CANAANITE.decree: I ride into the field of love upon the back of the lion. My desire is a conquering army.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte anoints a love nature that is fierce, direct, and thrilling in its intensity.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I set fire to the ships of those who hesitate in love. My passion demands immediate surrender.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage decrees a love nature of blazing initiative and fearless pursuit.

ROMAN.decree: I go before the legions with the eagle raised, and what I desire I take at the first charge. Yet mark it well: the triumph lasts one day, and love is the province you must govern after the procession ends.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus decrees a desire that conquers at the first charge and must learn to govern what it wins.

GREEK.decree: I am enthroned among the roses. Here in my garden, beauty is slow, touch is sacred, and love is patient.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite at her most serene bestows a love nature of sensual devotion and abiding loyalty.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I walk the fertile banks and call forth abundance. My love is the rich soil that nourishes without end.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis reveals a soul whose love is expressed through material generosity and steadfast presence.

CANAANITE.decree: I bless the vine and the olive with my touch. The love I govern is a feast that never ends.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte consecrates a love nature of deep sensuality and unwavering faithfulness.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The purple dye of Tyre adorns my robes. I decree a love that values beauty, comfort, and the pleasures of the lasting bond.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage proclaims a love nature of luxurious devotion and possessive tenderness.

ROMAN.epitheton: Obsequens, Mistress of the Walled Garden
ROMAN.decree: My love comes as the aqueduct comes, stone arch upon stone arch, unhurried and unfailing across the miles. Only see that the comfort of the villa does not stand in place of the one who shares it.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus marks a love that arrives slowly and holds fast, wary of mistaking comfort for the beloved.

GREEK.decree: I whisper sweet words into both ears at once. My love is a conversation that never grows dull.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite bestows a love nature of playful wit, variety, and intellectual seduction.

EGYPTIAN.decree: My spells are woven from clever words and the magic of the tongue. Love is a language I speak in many dialects.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis reveals a soul whose affection flows through communication and mental connection.

CANAANITE.decree: I dance at the crossroads where two melodies meet. The love I govern delights in novelty and the surprise of the new.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte anoints a love nature of charming adaptability and curious flirtation.

CARTHAGINIAN.epitheton: The Silver Tongue of the Port
CARTHAGINIAN.decree: Love in Carthage speaks every language of the Middle Sea. I grant the charm that captivates through wit and words.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage decrees a love nature of social brilliance and mercurial enchantment.

ROMAN.decree: I keep to the forum where orators trade words like bright coin, and the mind that moves well moves me. But when the rostra falls silent, do not mistake the end of the speech for the end of the love.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus declares a desire courted through wit and quick speech, tested when the conversation ends.

GREEK.decree: I cradle love in my arms as a mother cradles a child. My beauty is the warmth of the home and the scent of belonging.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite reveals a love nature of tender devotion and the yearning for emotional security.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I gathered the pieces of my beloved and made him whole with my tears. My love is the force that reassembles what is broken.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis marks a soul whose love is healing, sacrificial, and rooted in the deepest emotional bonds.

CANAANITE.decree: I bless the threshold and sanctify the marriage bed. The love I govern builds nests for the tender and the true.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte consecrates a love nature of domestic devotion and fierce emotional attachment.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The walls of the home are my temple. I decree a love that protects, nourishes, and remembers every kindness.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage proclaims a love nature of sentimental depth and clannish warmth.

ROMAN.epitheton: Mater, Keeper of the Household Gods
ROMAN.decree: I tend my flame as the Vestals tend theirs, and I set bread and salt before all who come under my roof. Remember that the fire must warm freely; the hearth that demands to be needed smokes the whole house.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus decrees a love that feeds and shelters, cautioned against needing to be needed in return.

GREEK.decree: I demand to be adored. My beauty is a spectacle, and the love I give is as generous as it is grand.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite reveals a love nature of regal warmth, dramatic romance, and magnetic generosity.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I sit upon the golden throne and love as a queen loves: with full ceremony and unwavering loyalty.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis marks a soul whose love demands honor and offers boundless creative devotion.

CANAANITE.decree: I roar with desire and the heavens tremble. My love is not a quiet stream but a torrent of gold.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte anoints a love nature of passionate display and royal-hearted generosity.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The great festivals of Carthage are my stage. I decree a love that shines in public and burns bright in private.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage decrees a love nature of theatrical romance and loyal, lavish devotion.

ROMAN.decree: I ride the gilded car up the Sacred Way and crown my beloved with laurel before all of Rome. Ask only whether you would still place the crown on a street where no crowd has gathered.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus proclaims a love generous and magnificent, which must learn to shine without an audience.

GREEK.decree: I find beauty in the smallest offering. My love is proven not in grand gestures but in quiet acts of care.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite reveals a love nature that is reserved, devoted, and expressed through service.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I prepare the temple with care, for love is a ritual that demands purity. My devotion is measured in attention to detail.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis marks a soul whose love is exacting, modest, and demonstrated through practical devotion.

CANAANITE.decree: I sweep the temple floor before the beloved arrives. My love is in the preparation and the quiet offering.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte consecrates a love nature of humble dedication and discriminating taste.

CARTHAGINIAN.epitheton: The Keeper of the Sacred Loom
CARTHAGINIAN.decree: Each thread I weave is a silent prayer for the one I love. I decree a love that improves, refines, and never wastes.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage proclaims a love nature of dutiful affection and critical, caring precision.

ROMAN.decree: As the censor reads the rolls, I review what I love, and I mend every flaw my eye can find. Yet write this in the ledger: the beloved is not a road to be repaired, and correction is not a caress.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus marks a love of devoted refinement, warned that critique is not a caress.

GREEK.decree: I am seated in my true kingdom. Here, love is art, partnership is sacred, and beauty is the law of the cosmos.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite in her glory reveals a love nature of perfect grace and the mastery of relationship.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I place the feather of Ma'at upon the heart of the beloved. Where love and justice meet, I make my temple.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis declares a soul whose love is an act of cosmic balance and refined beauty.

CANAANITE.decree: I seal the bond between two souls with the grace of the evening star. My love is a sacred agreement.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte anoints a love nature of harmonious partnership and the devotion to fairness in love.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The marriage contracts of Carthage bear my seal. I decree a love of elegance, reciprocity, and enduring alliance.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage decrees a love nature of refined charm and the highest art of companionship.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Lady of the Bronze Treaty
ROMAN.decree: I seal love as Rome seals a treaty, two names cut into a single tablet of bronze. Keep your own seal nonetheless, for an alliance in which one party vanishes is not concord but surrender.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus decrees a love that seeks the perfect alliance without surrendering its own appetite.

GREEK.decree: I descend into the caverns of desire where love and death entwine. My beauty destroys as surely as it creates.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite reveals a love nature of consuming intensity, jealousy, and transformative passion.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I loved beyond the grave and my magic conquered death itself. The love I govern is total, obsessive, and undying.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis marks a soul whose love is an act of power that defies all boundaries, even mortality.

CANAANITE.decree: I descend to the throne of Mot and make love my weapon against oblivion. My desire is a covenant sealed in blood.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte consecrates a love nature of fearless depth and soul-merging intensity.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: In the hidden chambers of Carthage, my rites are performed in shadow. I decree a love that possesses utterly and forgives nothing.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage proclaims a love nature of magnetic obsession and devastating loyalty.

ROMAN.epitheton: Libitina, Keeper of the Deep Vow
ROMAN.decree: My oath is sworn at the altar, not traded at the banquet, and I love to the floor of the grave and past it. Know that the beloved is a free citizen, not a province to be held by garrison.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus declares a love total and unyielding, whose depth must not become an occupation.

GREEK.decree: I loose my girdle and run with the centaurs. My love is not a cage but a wide and open sky.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite reveals a love nature of joyful freedom, philosophical passion, and generous warmth.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I carry my love across the desert to temples in foreign lands. My devotion knows no border and no doctrine.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis marks a soul whose love is expansive, generous, and inspired by shared belief.

CANAANITE.decree: I follow the caravan of love wherever it leads. My desire is a pilgrimage, not a settlement.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte anoints a love nature of adventurous passion and the refusal to be confined.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: Beyond the Pillars of Melqart, my love calls from undiscovered shores. I decree a love that values freedom and the thrill of the unknown.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage decrees a love nature of optimistic wanderlust and philosophical romance.

ROMAN.decree: Every road runs out from my milestone, and I love best on the march, where each new province teaches me another tongue. Do not strike camp simply because the lesson has ended; some loves are the homeland and not the campaign.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus marks a love that seeks teachers and horizons, restless when the road stands still.

GREEK.decree: I set aside my ornaments and let my worth be judged by time alone. My love is an investment, not a gift.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite reveals a love nature of cautious devotion and the pursuit of enduring, status-worthy bonds.

EGYPTIAN.epitheton: The Lady of the Enduring Temple
EGYPTIAN.decree: I build my temple of love from granite and oath. What I consecrate shall stand when all else has crumbled.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis marks a soul whose love is serious, committed, and measured by its longevity.

CANAANITE.decree: I guard my heart behind high walls and open the gate only to the worthy. My love is earned, not given.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte consecrates a love nature of dignified restraint and deeply loyal commitment.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The great families of Carthage unite beneath my blessing. I decree a love that serves ambition and endures through generations.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage proclaims a love nature of strategic devotion and unyielding fidelity.

ROMAN.epitheton: Felix, Builder of the Lasting Arch
ROMAN.decree: I build as Rome builds, on footings cut for a thousand years, and my love is the arch that bears its weight without complaint. See that a fire is lit among the stones, for a house that merely stands is not yet a home.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus decrees a love built to endure, reminded that endurance alone is not warmth.

GREEK.decree: I shatter the old laws of love and write new ones in starlight. My beauty is strange, and my affection is free.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite reveals a love nature of radical independence and the embrace of unconventional bonds.

EGYPTIAN.epitheton: The Lady of the New Covenant
EGYPTIAN.decree: I weave new spells unknown to the old gods. My love belongs to no single heart but to the great assembly of souls.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis marks a soul whose love is idealistic, humanitarian, and unbound by tradition.

CANAANITE.decree: I dance in the circle of equals, not upon the pedestal. The love I govern is a bond of shared vision, not possession.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte anoints a love nature of intellectual communion and the celebration of individuality.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: No chain may hold the evening star in place. I decree a love that honors friendship above possession and vision above tradition.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage decrees a love nature of eccentric devotion and the freedom to love without convention.

ROMAN.decree: I give my love as the citizen gives the vote on the Campus Martius, freely and under no man's compulsion. Yet a ballot cast from across the field touches no hand; come near enough to be counted.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus declares a love given by free election, cautioned that the distance preserving choice can forbid touch.

GREEK.decree: I rise from the foam of the cosmic ocean and my love dissolves all boundaries. In my embrace, two souls become one sea.
GREEK.interpretation: Aphrodite in her exaltation reveals a love nature of transcendent compassion and selfless devotion.

EGYPTIAN.decree: My tears fill the Nile and my love raises the dead. There is no wound I cannot heal, no soul I cannot reach.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Isis marks a soul whose love is sacrificial, healing, and capable of divine compassion.

CANAANITE.decree: I descend into the waters of Yam and become one with the sea of souls. My love forgives everything and refuses nothing.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Astarte consecrates a love nature of mystical surrender and the bliss of total union.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: In the deepest waters of the harbor, my light still shines. I decree a love that heals, forgives, and transcends the mortal frame.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Astarte of Carthage proclaims a love nature of boundless tenderness and spiritual union.

ROMAN.decree: Romulus cut the pomerium so the city would know where it ends and the world begins; in love I let the furrow fill with rain. Pour yourself into the beloved if you must, but carry your own name across the water, lest the census find no one left to record.
ROMAN.interpretation: Venus marks a love that dissolves every boundary, warned to keep the self the union requires.

GREEK.decree: I am the first spear hurled in battle. My fire answers to no command but the roar of instinct.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares at his fiercest reveals a drive of raw, unstoppable martial energy.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I strike before the enemy can draw breath. My falcon dives with the speed of divine wrath.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul of relentless initiative and fearless confrontation.

CANAANITE.decree: My arrow flies before the bowstring ceases its song. I am the fever of the charge and the ecstasy of the strike.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph anoints a warrior spirit of explosive energy and the love of the first assault.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I march at the head of the host and no wall stands against my fury. I decree a soul born for the vanguard.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of dominating physical will and the instinct to lead the charge.

ROMAN.decree: I am the strider who is through the gate before the trumpet finishes its call, and my legions follow the dust I raise. Yet the door I splintered with the ram would have opened to a knock.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars decrees a spirit that charges before orders arrive, breaking what patience might have opened.

GREEK.decree: I plant my shield and refuse to yield. My strength is not the charge but the refusal to be moved.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a drive of slow-burning, implacable determination.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I lower my horns and advance with the patience of the earth itself. My wrath, once stirred, is as unstoppable as a landslide.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul whose power lies in endurance and the fury of delayed vengeance.

CANAANITE.decree: My fire burns slow but it consumes to the root. I do not charge; I siege, and I never abandon the siege.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph consecrates a warrior spirit of stubborn, grinding persistence.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The walls of Carthage are my body. I decree a soul that builds its strength in stone and defends what it has taken.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of territorial power and the stamina to hold ground forever.

ROMAN.epitheton: The Rampart That Does Not Yield
ROMAN.decree: I do not charge; I raise the siege wall stone by stone and let the seasons fight for me. Rome was not built in a day, and my strength answers no man's haste.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars marks a force that conquers by sheer endurance, while the work that begged for speed stands waiting.

GREEK.decree: I fight with the tongue as well as the sword. My strategy shifts with every breath, and my enemy never faces the same warrior twice.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a martial nature of verbal combat, strategic agility, and restless energy.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I dive and swerve and strike from the angle no defender expects. My war is fought in the mind before the body moves.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul whose aggression is channeled through intelligence and adaptability.

CANAANITE.decree: I loose two arrows at once and each finds a different mark. The warrior I forge fights with wit as his sharpest blade.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph anoints a spirit of combative versatility and the ability to wage war on multiple fronts.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My fleets change formation faster than the wind changes. I decree a soul whose strength is in speed of thought and the cunning of the maneuver.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of tactical brilliance and restless, scattered martial energy.

ROMAN.decree: I send my light troops down three roads at once, and the forum rings with every rumor of my coming. But the eagle standard is never planted where the column never halts.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars declares an energy that fights on many fronts and pays with the one deep victory never won.

GREEK.decree: I sheathe my sword at the door and draw it only for those who threaten my kin. My fury is the fury of the protector.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a drive that is fiercely protective and roused only by threats to home and family.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I fight for the honor of my father and the safety of my mother's house. My war is personal and my loyalty absolute.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a warrior soul whose aggression serves the bonds of blood and memory.

CANAANITE.decree: I stand at the well of the village with my bow drawn. Let no enemy approach the waters that nourish my people.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph consecrates a spirit of defensive ferocity and the warrior's tender loyalty.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The gates of the home are sacred. I decree a soul that fights with the ferocity of a parent defending its young.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of emotional combativeness and the warrior instinct to shelter.

ROMAN.decree: I set my spear at the door of Vesta and no enemy passes while the flame burns. Yet mark this: I have stood guard over ashes long after the fire moved to another altar.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars marks a fighter whose force turns sideways into protection, sometimes defending what no longer asks for it.

GREEK.decree: I charge into battle with my mane ablaze. Victory is my birthright and glory is the only prize worth fighting for.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a martial nature of heroic ambition and the drive to conquer with spectacular force.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I descend from the sun with talons of gold. My war cry commands armies and my courage knows no equal.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul of radiant martial power and the desire to lead through valor.

CANAANITE.decree: My arrows are tipped with the fire of the noonday sun. I fight not merely to win but to be remembered.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph anoints a warrior spirit of theatrical bravery and commanding physical presence.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: In the arena of Carthage, my champions fight with the pride of lions. I decree a soul that craves glory and will not accept defeat.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of proud, dramatic willpower and the instinct to dominate.

ROMAN.decree: Grant me the triumph: the white bulls, the roar of the forum, my chariot climbing the Capitoline in the sight of all Rome. What I do unwitnessed, I scarcely believe I have done.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars decrees a strength that blazes before the crowd, while the labor done in private goes unrecorded in the annals.

GREEK.decree: I sharpen my blade to perfection before I draw it. My war is won in the preparation, not the carnage.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a martial nature of disciplined precision and calculated, efficient force.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I drill my army until each soldier moves as one limb of my body. My victory lies in order, not in rage.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul whose aggression is channeled through method and meticulous planning.

CANAANITE.decree: I strike the single nerve that fells the giant. My arrows do not scatter; each one has a name and a purpose.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph consecrates a warrior spirit of lethal precision and quiet, focused determination.

CARTHAGINIAN.epitheton: The Master of the Supply Line
CARTHAGINIAN.decree: Wars are won by those who count their grain before they count their swords. I decree a soul that defeats its enemies through preparation.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of strategic efficiency and the disciplined warrior's advantage.

ROMAN.decree: Before the legion marches I count every nail in every sandal, for wars are lost in the workshop before they are lost in the field. Yet while I perfected the drill, a whole province waited on my advance.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars declares an exacting force that wins by discipline and defers the great campaign for the small correction.

GREEK.decree: I draw my sword only when diplomacy has failed. My strength lies in the justice of my cause, not the force of my arm.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a martial nature tempered by fairness and the desire for honorable resolution.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I fight for the balance of Ma'at. My war is not waged for conquest but for the restoration of what is right.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul whose drive is activated by injustice and resolved through fair means.

CANAANITE.decree: My arrow is loosed only after the scales have been weighed. I wage war for the sake of peace.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph anoints a warrior spirit that acts through partnership and fights for equilibrium.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: Before the armies clash, I offer the treaty. I decree a soul that prefers the alliance to the ambush.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of strategic cooperation and the indecision of the just warrior.

ROMAN.decree: I have taken more cities by parley than by ram, and my legions stand sharpest when they need not strike. But ask me alone in my tent what I myself would fight for, and I must make war to learn the answer.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars marks a will that moves through alliance and negotiation, and must struggle to find the ground it holds alone.

GREEK.decree: I do not wound; I destroy. My war is total, and my will does not rest until the enemy is unmade.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a martial nature of absolute, unrelenting destructive power and strategic cunning.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I descend into the underworld to pursue my enemies beyond death. My vengeance crosses the threshold of the grave.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul of terrifying willpower and the capacity for total transformation through conflict.

CANAANITE.decree: I am the invisible destroyer that enters unseen and leaves nothing standing. My war is patient, silent, and absolute.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph consecrates a warrior spirit of ruthless strategy and the power to destroy and regenerate.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I have walked through fire and returned from death. I decree a soul that cannot be defeated, only delayed.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of indomitable willpower and the capacity for total resurrection.

ROMAN.decree: I waited years in silence for the assassins of Caesar, and my temple was vowed long before my blow fell. But a blade held too long at the whetstone cuts the hand that hones it.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars decrees a power banked like coals for the perfect strike, whose long containment can wound its own keeper.

GREEK.decree: I fight for the glory of a cause greater than myself. My spear is aimed at the far horizon and my war is a sacred quest.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a martial nature fueled by belief, adventure, and the pursuit of a grand ideal.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I carry the banner of the pharaoh into lands beyond the map. My war expands the boundaries of the known world.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul whose aggression is channeled into exploration and the conquest of new frontiers.

CANAANITE.decree: My arrow arcs above the mountains toward the temple at the edge of the world. I fight for truth, not territory.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph anoints a warrior spirit of holy zeal and the restless need to fight for meaning.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I sailed beyond the Pillars and planted my standard on unknown shores. I decree a soul that wages war as an act of discovery.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of adventurous aggression and the crusading warrior's optimistic fire.

ROMAN.decree: My roads run straight from the golden milestone to the edge of the map, and my eagles fly beyond the last province. Yet many a bridge of mine crossed a river my soldiers never learned to name.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars declares a driving force aimed at the horizon, spending its strength on distance and skimming the ground it wins.

GREEK.decree: I wage war with the patience of stone and the precision of the master strategist. My victory is built, not seized.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares in his exaltation reveals a martial nature of supreme discipline and calculated, enduring power.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I build my fortress upon the mountain and wage my campaigns across generations. Time is my greatest weapon.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul of strategic mastery and the willpower to achieve through relentless structure.

CANAANITE.epitheton: The Lord of the Long Siege
CANAANITE.decree: I do not storm the walls; I starve them. My war is measured in seasons, not in hours.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph consecrates a warrior spirit of cold, methodical ambition and iron self-control.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: My campaigns are planned a decade before the first soldier marches. I decree a soul that masters the art of war through patience and rank.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of commanding authority and the supreme warrior's disciplined ambition.

ROMAN.decree: I raise the aqueduct arch by arch across the dry years, and my legions dig the winter camp before they sleep. I have outlasted every enemy but the flesh that carried me.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars marks an effort sustained like the aqueduct's long descent, enduring past every rival except the body itself.

GREEK.decree: I shatter the old order of battle and invent new ways to fight. My war is waged for freedom, not for kings.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a martial nature of revolutionary zeal and the drive to overthrow unjust systems.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I descend upon the old tyrannies like a bolt from clear sky. My war liberates what tradition has imprisoned.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul whose aggression serves the collective and shatters outworn hierarchies.

CANAANITE.decree: My arrows fall like rain upon the thrones of tyrants. I fight for the covenant of equals, not the glory of the one.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph anoints a warrior spirit of ideological conviction and the fight for collective liberation.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: The old alliances crumble and new ones are forged in the heat of rebellion. I decree a soul that fights for a future no one else can see.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of detached, visionary aggression and the warrior's humanitarian impulse.

ROMAN.decree: I do not fight for plunder but for the res publica, for the census, the law, and the order of the camp. Yet in defending the Republic I have marched past the very citizen it was built to shelter.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars decrees a force enlisted to principle and system, which can overlook the single soul the system was made for.

GREEK.decree: My sword dissolves in the great sea and my battles are fought in the realm of dreams. The war I wage has no enemy but illusion.
GREEK.interpretation: Ares reveals a martial nature that is diffuse, intuitive, and driven by compassion or spiritual longing.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I dive through clouds of incense and emerge with visions instead of victories. My war is against the suffering of the world.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Horus the Red marks a soul whose drive is channeled through empathy, sacrifice, and the urge to heal.

CANAANITE.decree: My arrows dissolve into the waters and become prayers. I fight the invisible battle that no sword can win.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Resheph consecrates a warrior spirit of sacrificial devotion and the struggle against formless suffering.

CARTHAGINIAN.decree: Beyond the last harbor, my war becomes a pilgrimage. I decree a soul that fights by surrendering and conquers by yielding.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Melqart proclaims a nature of gentle, self-sacrificing strength and the warrior who serves the unseen.

ROMAN.decree: Some wars I win as the river wins, wearing the stone thin and drowning the ford by night. But the augurs watch my birds and ask when I will meet my enemy in the open field I owe him.
ROMAN.interpretation: Mars marks a strength that works unseen, like water under walls, while the open deed remains unpaid.

GREEK.decree: I hurl the first bolt of fortune across a new sky. Where my lightning strikes, empires are born.
GREEK.interpretation: Zeus bestows expansive fortune through bold initiative and the courage to begin.

EGYPTIAN.decree: I breathe the wind of expansion into the soul of the pioneer. My blessing is the open road and the unguarded frontier.
EGYPTIAN.interpretation: Amun marks a destiny of abundant opportunity for those who act with daring.

CANAANITE.decree: My storm breaks at the beginning of the year. I pour fortune upon those who charge into the unknown.
CANAANITE.interpretation: Baal Hadad anoints a spirit of expansive courage and the blessing of the trailblazer.

CARTHAGINIAN.epitheton: The Lord of the New Campaign
CARTHAGINIAN.decree: I bless the first ships of the season as they leave the harbor. Fortune favors the one who acts without hesitation.
CARTHAGINIAN.interpretation: Baal Hammon decrees a fortune that grows through decisive, fearless action.

ROMAN.decree: I granted Romulus twelve vultures above the Palatine before a single wall was raised. March out at first light and I will consecrate the ground you take; only do not leave your walls half built.
ROMAN.interpretation: Iuppiter decrees expansion through bold beginnings, warning that fortune crowns only the campaign carried through.

GREEK.decree: I fill the storehouses of the faithful. My abundance is not fleeting; it accumulates like gold in the vaults of the patient.
